speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No known malignancies or hereditary diseases in the family. Previous treatments for syphilis and eczema. Social history: Lives with his 4th wife, smokes 2 packs of cigarettes per day for the last 30 years, has recently immigrated from Africa.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit. The combination of chronic non-healing ulcerated lesions, significant tobacco exposure, and lack of response to prior antifungal/antibiotic therapies is highly suggestive of malignancy. I recommend immediate biopsy of both lesions for histopathological confirmation and staging.
